description: Document-derived sales-side records (directive 27b95ec2180b): customer purchase orders and delivery receipts / proofs of delivery the document-field extractor reads from captured mail attachments and SharePoint files (ontology/document_fields.py, classes customer_po and delivery_receipt). Every value is a page/span-cited machine-read lead; each document links to the SalesOrder or Shipment it names (lead mentions), and plx.object compares what it attests with the record (attests in ontology/schema/document_fields.json): a disagreement is a conflict, a value the record holds empty a missing_in_record lead, never a pick and never a write.

object_types.description: A customer's purchase order to PLX, projected from captured mail attachments and SharePoint files the document-field extractor recognises (ontology/document_fields.py, class customer_po): PO number, dates, parties, shipping terms and line items, each a machine-read lead cited to the original bytes (page and span). Linked to the SalesOrder it names; plx.object reports a PO number the order holds empty as a missing_in_record lead (operating/attested_conflicts.py), never a write.

bindings.note: One object per captured mail attachments version recognised as class customer_po (ontology/schema/document_fields.json); keyed by the source record, cited by its byte-pinned handle, same audience and validity interval as the source version.

One object per captured SharePoint files version recognised as class customer_po (ontology/schema/document_fields.json); keyed by the source record, cited by its byte-pinned handle, same audience and validity interval as the source version.
